captureRule: At successful ending, bind SAME ward lord ID before and after; verify event-year minus birthYear is finite safe integer >=21. Snapshot before.lordship.wardship.guardianId: nonempty string -> named_guardian; null -> overlord by engine convention; missing/invalid unknown. Do not infer mother/kin from role or current state.
reconstruction: Unknown for old records without this verified event-time snapshot. Never fill from current persons, estates or office holders.

captureRule: Match params predecessorId and leaderId to exact event identities. Require predecessor explicitly dead and successor explicitly alive. Snapshot predecessor householdId from before persons people/past and successor householdId after; both nonempty valid IDs. Equal -> same_household else different_household. No inference of blood kin, hereditary right, rivalry, or motive.

captureRule: Capture in per-estate oversight loop, retaining estate ID even though current history record lacks it. Require prior/current steward IDs equal record params, deceased explicitly dead, successor exists and alive=true in estates.people, prior.mode==after.mode. direct/steward only. Multiple estate matches without capture identity -> unknown. No current-state backfill or promises of loyal/competent successor.

captureRule: At new oversight require after mode=direct, estate offMap=true and titleHolder=possessor=lord, appointed person exists alive=true. Count distinct after oversight estate IDs whose after estates are offMap and held in BOTH title/possession by lord, including this estate. One -> sole_estate, greater than one -> multiple_estates; zero/duplicate/invalid -> unknown. This describes concurrent oversight portfolio only, not lifetime first acquisition. Multiple additions share after snapshot; never invent ordering.
